item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 29/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the upper-air disturbance departing, showers will ease off over the coast of southern China today. Tropical Cyclone Krathon will linger over the east of Luzon Strait and continue to intensify today and tomorrow. It will then move towards the vicinity of Taiwan to the East China Sea. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, the weather will be very hot over the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. A fresh to strong northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong on Tuesday. The weather will be slightly cooler and dry over the region in the middle and latter parts of this week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.
